description: Deliberate test (delivery_failure_alerts): Invoke the log normalizer with an event it cannot process, so the log delivery path fails; its error alarm must enter ALARM, which notifies the detection topic. The newest recorded run must have passed within 30 days

matrix_rows.gap: Run every 30 days by the operator and recorded, not every 3: the test changes or provokes the account, so it does not run unattended.
